title: Trace Propagation Plan
description: A structured plan for W3C Trace Context propagation and sampling, so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/trace_propagation_audit.mjs.

propagator.description: The propagation scheme: W3C traceparent, legacy B3, a composite (W3C + legacy) for migration, or a vendor-proprietary header set.

samplingStrategy.description: Head (SDK, trace-id ratio), tail (collector, whole-trace policies), both (head baseline + tail enrichment), or always-on (100%).

legacyUpstreamsRemain.description: True if any upstream service still emits only B3 / X-Ray / vendor headers.

newParentIdPerSpan.description: True if every service allocates a fresh span_id (parent-id) for outgoing traceparent headers instead of forwarding the incoming one.

traceparentLowercaseHexValidated.description: True if emitted traceparent headers are asserted to be exactly 55 chars of lowercase hex with correct separators (fixtures or boundary tests).

needErrorSampling.description: True if the team requires that traces containing errors are always sampled.

productionSampleRatePercent.description: The baseline percentage of traces sampled in production.

sqlCommenterEnabled.description: True if HTTP->SQL propagation via sqlcommenter comments is part of the plan.

sqlCommenterDefaultOn.description: True if sqlcommenter is enabled by default rather than as an explicit opt-in (the OTel spec says it SHOULD NOT be default-on).

dbSystem.description: The database system receiving sqlcommenter comments; MySQL/Oracle/SQL Server have plan-cache impact.

piiInTracestate.description: True if user-identifying attributes are carried in the tracestate header (they must not be).
